title.en: An Act to Reclassify the Whole Land Within the Island Known as Ramesamey/Cowrie Island in the City of Puerto Princesa, Province of Palawan From Timberland to That of Alienable and Disposable Land
title.orig: An Act to Reclassify the Whole Land Within the Island Known as Ramesamey/Cowrie Island in the City of Puerto Princesa, Province of Palawan From Timberland to That of Alienable and Disposable Land

text.en:
The land comprising the whole island known as Ramesamey/Cowrie Island situated in the City of Puerto Princesa, Province of Palawan is hereby reclassified from timberland to that of alienable and disposable land which is particularly described as follows:
Beginning at a point marked "1" being N 09-18 E 11,123.29 M. from BLLM No.1, Cad-800-D Puerto Princesa City Cadastre, Palawan, thence N 51-39 W 87.19 M to point 2; N 14-43 E 13.90 M to point 3; N 66-07 E 14.68 M to point 4; N 88-26 E 105.78 M to point 5; S 71-25 E 86.06 to point 6; S 61-60 E 64.55 M to point 7; S 45-14 E 98.70 M to point 8; S 66-51E 50.99 to point 9; S 60-37 W 80.01 M to point 10; S 78-50 W 43-61M to point 11; N 69-41W 64.45 to point 12; N 54-53 W 167.35 M to point of beginning.
Containing an area of thirty-four thousand five hundred seventy-two (34,572) square meters.
The Secretary of the Department of Environment and Natural Resources shall issue all the necessary orders, rules and circulars to implement the provisions of this Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
